exposure: duration of urinary catheterization (6 hours vs. 24 hours)
cohort: A cohort of 126 pregnant women undergoing Caesarean section under spinal anesthesia at Rama Medical College.
finding: Early catheter removal (6 hours) after Caesarean section led to significantly fewer urinary tract infections/bacteriuria and earlier ambulation compared to 24-hour catheterization, though it was associated with a higher rate of urinary retention.
followup_time: Up to 10 days post-discharge for those with significant bacteriuria; otherwise, by hospital discharge (around day 3).
cross-section timing: Post-Caesarean section, during immediate recovery and hospital stay.
